   iterate descendingIterator over dynamicScopes, for each scope, get containingSchema, if not null && containingSchema.isDynamicAnchor() return containingSchema
- return context.findLexicalRoot()

The method will iterate descending over dynamicScopes (i.e., from newest to oldest). It will find childSchema first (if dynamic anchor) and return it. So we can verify that.
